Looping in ops & CS. Quick read: 1) Dedicated pool is effectively saturated and reserved throughput is degraded because of long-sequence jobs from two non-reserved tenants; autoscaling didn't add equivalent headroom quickly enough. 2) There is an immediate instrumentation gap — we need per-reservation queue depth in the dashboard (tracking ticket CR-4821).

Suggested mitigations (short term):
- Authorize emergency burst (60m) to a higher-performance node type with cost offset as credit (requires sales/finance sign-off).
- Apply a temporary model-fallback policy: route ClearWave's traffic to a compatible quantized variant (same quality guardrails) to reduce per-token compute.
- Prioritize ClearWave's KV cache and pin hot prefixes to avoid misses.

I can take point on the runbook if we get exec OK. Rafael — can infra prepare the burst nodes and a rollback plan? Naomi — ready CS to coordinate customer comms.

Marissa

Devon — final update and post-mortem notes:

Timeline summary:
- 07:30 PT (Feb 1): ClearWave begins seeing latency/5xx spike.
- 08:20 PT: Redwood ops identifies 98% sustained GPU utilization on the dedicated cluster and high KV cache miss amplification.
- 09:05 PT: Emergency burst authorized; infra began provisioning high-throughput nodes.
- 09:30 PT: Model-fallback routing applied for latency-sensitive endpoints; KV pin + prefix caching enabled.
- 10:15 PT: Error rate and median latency returned within SLA; queue depth normalized.

Root cause (short): autoscaler response lag + concurrent long-sequence workloads from non-reserved tenants amplified KV cache miss rate, exhausting headroom. Recommendations and follow-up actions:
1) Per-reservation queue metrics (CR-4821) — priority instrumentation item.
2) Autoscaler tuning: pre-warm policy around ClearWave's peak windows + lower scaling thresholds for reserved pools.
3) Define a standard emergency-burst authorization flow (billing threshold and executive contacts) and a templated commercial credit (aditya to own).
4) Long-term: support per-reservation isolation (soft-caged compute) workstream — infra & product sync scheduled next week.

Attachments: proposed_burst_plan_v2.pdf (contains rollback steps, runbook, cost breakdown).

We're keeping this ticket open for root-cause validation and will run a joint RCA with ClearWave next week. Appreciate the quick coordination and sorry for the disruption.

—Rafael Mendes
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
